skill.resume: Pick up where you left off
skill.meter: {n} of 5 recent answers right on your own
lesson.check.intro: A few questions with no hints. Take your time.
lesson.notyet: Not mastered yet. Keep practicing and it will come.
lesson.returnpath: You took a side trip: {path}. Now you are back.
feedback.quick: That was quick. Take a moment and work it out.
feedback.wrong.again: Not that one. Look at the picture again, then try once more.
feedback.invalid.both: Fill in both the top and the bottom.
feedback.invalid.zero: The bottom can't be 0. It tells how many pieces make one whole.
feedback.notbigger: That is the same fraction. Write one with a bigger bottom number.
hint.equiv.missing-part.1: Every piece was cut into the same number of smaller pieces. The shaded part did not change.
hint.equiv.missing-part.2.numerator: What number turns {b} into {bk}? Use that same number on the top.
hint.equiv.missing-part.2.denominator: What number turns {a} into {ak}? Use that same number on the bottom.
hint.equiv.is-equivalent.1: Draw both fractions in your head. Do they cover the same amount?
hint.equiv.is-equivalent.2: Check: did the top and the bottom both get multiplied by the same number?
hint.equiv.find-pair.1: Cut every piece of {a_over_b} into smaller pieces. Count the shaded ones and all of them.
hint.equiv.find-pair.2: Pick a number. Multiply the top by it. Multiply the bottom by the same number.
hint.meaning.name-fraction.1: The bottom tells how many equal pieces make one whole. The top tells how many are shaded.
hint.meaning.name-fraction.2: Count all the pieces first. That number goes on the bottom.
item.missing-part.numerator: Fill in the top so the fractions are equal.
item.missing-part.denominator: Fill in the bottom so the fractions are equal.
item.is-equivalent: Are these two fractions the same amount?
item.find-pair: Write a fraction equal to {a_over_b} that has a bigger bottom number.
item.name-fraction: What fraction of the shape is shaded?
trace.split: Cut every piece into {k}. Now there are {d} pieces in the whole.
trace.merge: Join every {k} pieces into 1. Now there are {d} pieces in the whole.
trace.count.shaded: The shaded part did not change. {shaded} of {d} are shaded.
trace.write.notequiv: {left} and {right} are not the same amount.
trace.compare.same: Both pictures cover the same amount.
trace.name.pieces: The whole is cut into {d} equal pieces, so each piece is 1 {piece}.
trace.mult.groups: Make {a} groups with {b} in each group.
mis.scales-numerator-only.label: Multiplies only the top
mis.scales-numerator-only.fix: The top and the bottom both get multiplied by the same number.
mis.scales-denominator-only.label: Multiplies only the bottom
mis.scales-denominator-only.fix: The top and the bottom both get multiplied by the same number.
mis.adds-to-both.label: Adds to the top and bottom instead of multiplying
mis.adds-to-both.fix: Adding the same number to the top and the bottom changes the amount. Multiply instead.
mis.different-scale-factors.label: Multiplies the top and bottom by different numbers
mis.different-scale-factors.fix: Use the same number for the top and the bottom.
mis.whole-number-bias.label: Thinks different numbers always mean different amounts
mis.whole-number-bias.fix: Two fractions can look different and still cover the same amount.
mis.copies-fraction.label: Writes the same fraction back
mis.copies-fraction.fix: Cut the pieces smaller. The bottom number has to grow.
mis.arith-slip.label: Multiplication or division slip
mis.arith-slip.fix: The idea is right. Check the multiplying.
mis.counts-ticks-not-gaps.label: Counts tick marks instead of jumps
mis.counts-ticks-not-gaps.fix: Count the jumps between the marks, not the marks.
mis.part-over-part.label: Compares shaded to not shaded
mis.part-over-part.fix: The bottom counts all the pieces, shaded and not shaded.
mis.inverted-fraction.label: Swaps the top and the bottom
mis.inverted-fraction.fix: Shaded pieces go on top. All the pieces go on the bottom.
mis.adds-instead.label: Adds instead of multiplying
mis.adds-instead.fix: Times means groups of. Count all the groups together.
mis.off-by-one-group.label: Counts one group too many or too few
